Apple project engineering

Apple BOM

Build an Apple project bill of materials from a standard starting point or your own saved preset. Add, rename, or duplicate sections as the project requires. Quantities, descriptions, and product-document matching use the same catalog as the main BOM tool; pricing is not used.

Product document types

Choose one or more output formats. Duplicate product documents are removed automatically.

Lighting schedule automation

Apple DALI Schedule Generator

Combine a Bluebeam quantity export with one or more LIGHTING CONTROL PROGRAMMING sheets from a complete drawing-set PDF. Both files are processed in this browser and are not uploaded or saved.

Review combined schedule

Smart search syntax

Combine normal language with precise field searches.

part:
Part number or material, such as part:DIN-THSTAT
line:
Product line, such as line:"Zum Wired Lighting"
type:
Catalog product type, such as type:"Load Controllers"
doc:
Document type, such as doc:"Installation Guide"
product:
Words in a source product name
title:
Words in the manufacturer's original document title
file:
Words or codes in the local filename
ext:
File format: pdf, zip, docx, or doc
shared:
true or false
-term
Exclude a word, for example sensor -wireless
"phrase"
Require an exact phrase

The search understands common terms and abbreviations—“datasheet” finds spec sheets, “install” finds installation material, “CAD” finds drawings, and abbreviations such as THSTAT, PWS, KP, and BTN are expanded. Minor typing errors are tolerated.
